doc.name: Store replenishment: the flow compiler litmus fixture

$comment: Spec 06 section 9, statement 4: a store-replenishment relay flow with an EasyLoop-like lane, a compiler fixture only, never a template flow or a product example (rulings D91, D102). It stands on the map of the study it is checked against, adding the sectors the flow needs, and names no aisle, VTM or cohort but the free HTM fleet: each VTM segment is {assigned}, resolved per rack row by the compiler (D105).
